shared_elements: body ornamentation or attributes on figures
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic anthropomorphic imagery reduced to incised outlines, and each includes a prominent circular disc/ring motif (a large ring on a stalk in A; a concentric circle on the torso in B), but this is a generic correspondence. A is a scattered multi-figure scene of small stick-like people, boats and repeated sign rows spread over a flat surface, whereas B is a single frontal monolithic figure with symbols organised symmetrically on a face, chest and belt — different subject matter, composition and relationships entirely.
